newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran's NIOC aims to boost oil and gas reserves.
newsitem.headline: Iran's NIOC aims to boost oil and gas reserves.

text.p: National Iranian Oil Company (NIOC) aims to discover two billion barrels of additional oil and 25-50 trillion cubic feet of natural gas during the country's second five-year economic plan (1995-2000), the Tehran Times on Sunday quoted NIOC exploration chief Mehdi Husseini as saying.

Exploration projects at oil and gas fields in Kermanshah, Lorestan, Fars, Hormuzgan, Ilam and the main producing province of Khuzestan were being carried out, Husseini told the Times, according to the official IRNA news agency.
"Husseini said that drilling operations had already begun on 37 oil and gas wells," IRNA reported.

Iran's oil reserves are estimated at 92 billion barrels -- or just under 10 percent of total global crude desposits -- and its gas reserves of around 740 trillion cubic feet of gas are the second largest in the world behind Russia.
NIOC had recently signed a $4 million oil exploration deal with Senegal, Husseini told the Times.
Iran together with Russia and Turkmenistan had also agreed to increase cooperation to exploit oil and gas reserves in the Caspian, IRNA reported.
